Speech to Text

Dictate text with your voice using your browser's speech recognition. Live interim results, final transcript, multiple languages and one-click copy.

Speech recognition is not supported in this browser. Please use Chrome or Edge on desktop or Android.

Works in Chrome/Edge on desktop & Android. Requires microphone permission.

Speak after pressing Start...

📖 How to use

  1. Choose your language from the dropdown.
  2. Click Start and allow microphone access.
  3. Speak — interim results appear live, final text lands below.
  4. Click Copy to copy the transcript.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which browsers support speech to text?

Speech recognition is supported in Chrome and Edge on desktop and Android. Safari and Firefox currently do not support it.

How do I start dictating?

Click Start, allow microphone access when asked, and speak clearly. Click Stop when you are done.

Is my voice sent anywhere?

Recognition happens through your browser's built-in speech service, which may send audio to the browser vendor for processing.
